```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(lme4)
library(mediation)

```

Each model will estimate:
•	ACME: Average Causal Mediation Effect (indirect effect).
•	ADE: Average Direct Effect.
•	Total effect: Combined direct and indirect effect.

```{r}

# Identify which party received voluntary intentionality
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    voluntary_condition = case_when(
      str_detect(trial1_label, "[AS]_W") ~
        str_extract(trial1_label, "[AS]_W"),
      str_detect(trial2_label, "[AS]_W") ~
        str_extract(trial2_label, "[AS]_W"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    voluntary_party = case_when(
      voluntary_condition == "A_W" ~ "a",
      voluntary_condition == "S_W" ~ "s",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    vote_party = case_when(
      vote == "The Alliance Party of Northern Ireland" ~ "a",
      vote == "The Social Democratic Party (SDP)" ~ "s",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # 1 = participant voted for the voluntary party
    # 0 = participant voted for the forced party
    congruence = case_when(
      is.na(voluntary_party) | is.na(vote_party) ~ NA_integer_,
      voluntary_party == vote_party ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  )

# Check congruence
table(data$congruence, useNA = "ifany")
table(data$voluntary_condition,
      data$vote,
      data$congruence,
      useNA = "ifany")


# Reshape: one observation per party, per participant

mediation_long <- data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    id, voluntary_party, vote_party,
    matches("^[as]_(skill|comp|know|truth|sinc|princ|warm|kind|emp)$")
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^[as]_"),
    names_to = c("party", "item"),
    names_pattern = "^([as])_(.*)$",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(score = as.numeric(score)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = item,
    values_from = score
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # 1 = voluntary; 0 = forced
    intentionality = as.integer(party == voluntary_party),

    # 1 = party chosen; 0 = not chosen
    chosen = as.integer(party == vote_party),

    # Three trustworthiness composites
    competence = rowMeans(
      pick(skill, comp, know), na.rm = FALSE
    ),
    integrity = rowMeans(
      pick(truth, sinc, princ), na.rm = FALSE
    ),
    benevolence = rowMeans(
      pick(warm, kind, emp), na.rm = FALSE
    ),

    party = factor(party, levels = c("a", "s"))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    if_all(
      c(id, party, intentionality, chosen,
        competence, integrity, benevolence),
      ~ !is.na(.)
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  filter(n() == 2, n_distinct(party) == 2) %>%
  ungroup()

# Check the resulting dataset
n_distinct(mediation_long$id)
nrow(mediation_long)

table(mediation_long$intentionality,
      mediation_long$chosen)

```

# Mediation analysis

```{r}

# Function to run a separate mediation analysis

run_mediation <- function(mediator_name) {

  # Mediator model
  model_m <- lme4::lmer(
    as.formula(
      paste0(
        mediator_name,
        " ~ intentionality + party + (1 | id)"
      )
    ),
    data = mediation_long,
    REML = FALSE
  )

  # Outcome model: ordinary logistic regression
  model_y <- glm(
    as.formula(
      paste0(
        "chosen ~ intentionality + ",
        mediator_name,
        " + party"
      )
    ),
    data = mediation_long,
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )

  # Mediation analysis
  med <- mediation::mediate(
    model.m = model_m,
    model.y = model_y,
    treat = "intentionality",
    mediator = mediator_name,
    sims = 2000,
    boot = FALSE
  )

  list(
    mediator_model = model_m,
    outcome_model = model_y,
    mediation = med
  )
}

# sort any package conflicts between lmer and lme4 

# Detach lmerTest if it is currently loaded
if ("package:lmerTest" %in% search()) {
  detach("package:lmerTest", unload = TRUE)
}

# Load lme4
library(lme4)

# Check which function is being used (should be lme4 only)
find("lmer")

# Reproducible simulations
set.seed(123)

# H4a: Competence
H4a <- run_mediation("competence")

# H4b: Integrity
H4b <- run_mediation("integrity")

# H4c: Benevolence
H4c <- run_mediation("benevolence")

```

Extract models

```{r}

# H4a
summary(H4a$mediation)

# H4b
summary(H4b$mediation)

# H4c
summary(H4c$mediation)
```
